REMINDER: South Carolina, we have a burn ban in effect.

This prohibits all outdoor burning, including yard debris burning, prescribed burning, campfires, bonfires, and other recreational fires in all unincorporated areas of the state.

More than 16,000 acres have burned in Georgia this week due to ongoing wildfires. Let's protect our communities, wildlife, property, and firefighters.

South Carolina STRONG.

One of our first achievements in Congress was completing the restoration of Crab Bank Seabird Sanctuary off the coast of Mount Pleasant after it was devastated by hurricanes and erosion.

We worked with the Army Corps of Engineers, SCDNR, and local partners to rebuild over 32 acres of vital nesting habitat using dredged material from the Charleston Harbor Deepening Project.
